name: workflow-automation-engine
description: A small event-driven workflow automation engine: visual builder, BullMQ workers, PostgreSQL execution traces.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c white,gray,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w shared && npm run test:unit -w backend
